name: smwgraphics-super-princess-peach-storm-clouds
title: Super Princess Peach - Storm Clouds
description:
These are the storm clouds that appear in the 7th world of Super Princess Peach, Giddy Sky. Good for any thunderstorm levels.

Rykon-V73 Edit: Layer 3 BG uses extra to compensate for the free areas of the background. It uses 263 8x8 tiles.

You'll need either no status bar, any custom status bar (Minimalist, DKCR and etc) or a custom sprite status bar to make it work properly.
